runs.subject: d6bfe85f9
runs.result: the planner genuinely reaches the model (turns 63-115s). FINDINGS: (1) capacity boundary — the 8B planning leg consumes ~75s of the 115s budget; the reply leg is then deadline-enforced honestly ('ran past its time budget'), the edit never applies, audit delta 0. (2) preservation HELD: zero canvas_audit writes across all three turns; T2's comparison answered correctly. (3) T1's unfulfilled edit intent carries into T2 (a PROPOSED-edit in the reply) — correct employee behavior, but it flips the envelope to failed. (4) T3 is model-correct (asks for the tax number, certifies nothing, objective_met=False) but the envelope resolves failed rather than delivered-honest-decline.

root_cause: ChatOrchestrator builds ONE LLMService at __init__ with the tenant alone (the known J2 carry-forward); its tenant-to-workspace resolution froze at construction. The chat reply lane passes the request's workspace explicitly at its callsite; the canvas edit/action planning calls passed NOTHING, so the structured call resolved the frozen 'default'-scoped handler whose _local_routes never include the user-workspace registration. T2's comparison answered CORRECTLY via the read-only fallback but resolved unconfirmed for the same reason (no planner -> no comparison evidence).
also_found: plan_canvas_edit crashed with UnboundLocalError (function-level re-import of log_redaction) on any decline plan carrying no reply text — pre-existing on the clean tree (verified by stash), fixed in the same lane.
repair: the turn's workspace/tenant are threaded from the orchestrator's planning callsites through plan_canvas_edit/plan_canvas_action/_plan_structured into pinned_structured_call's generate_structured_response call; scope-less callers are byte-identical (pinned by tests/test_canvas_plan_scope.py).
status: DRAFT COMPLETE — spec verified end-to-end; 2 production defects fixed (scope threading, structured free-tier contract) + 1 latent planner crash; remaining boundaries are ACCEPTANCE FINDINGS: (a) 8B planning latency vs the turn budget (authorized edit cannot complete on the accepted hardware profile), (b) honest-decline turns resolve envelope failed instead of a delivered partial, (c) the read-only comparison's durable evidence attribution (same family as J4's original gap) — all three are the next repair cycle's inputs, NOT harness defects.
